comment: Recognition layer 2 — community and district signs. Coordinates are real-world lat/lon projected to world space via road.project() at runtime. radius = trigger distance in compressed-world units (~300 units per real km). needs_owner_review: true marks any entry where OSM-derived position may differ from the owner's lived knowledge — the owner's knowledge is authoritative.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow sand spit connecting Norman Manley Airport to Kingston — sea on both sides

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Eastern gateway into Kingston at the foot of the Palisadoes roundabout

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Named for the 17th-century fortress walls; the mineral bath is a Kingston institution

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: Hillside community overlooking eastern Kingston

communities.name: Franklin Town
communities.note: Eastern Kingston community along the Windward Road and Mountain View corridor

communities.name: Kingston
communities.note: Capital and largest city of Jamaica

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: The famous Kingston junction — north to Half Way Tree, east to downtown

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's modern business, hotel and shopping district

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: The commercial heart of St. Andrew — the 1813 clock tower marks its centre

communities.name: Hagley Park
communities.note: Western Kingston residential area along the Spanish Town Road corridor

communities.name: Trench Town
communities.note: West Kingston community that gave the world reggae — Bob Marley grew up here

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Jamaica's former capital since the 1500s — seat of St. Catherine parish

communities.name: Twickenham Park
communities.note: Community north of Spanish Town on the road to Bog Walk gorge

communities.name: Angels
communities.note: Small community at the foot of Bog Walk gorge

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Gateway to the Rio Cobre gorge — Flat Bridge is just ahead

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Market town in St. Catherine — immortalised in the folk song Linstead Market

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Cool hill-country junction — the watershed between St. Catherine and St. Ann

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary roadside cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam and festival

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: The spectacular canopy descent into Ocho Rios — bamboo arches overhead

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: St. Ann resort town — the end of the road and Dunn's River Falls awaits
